items.summary: A critical security vulnerability has been fixed in Fortinet's FortiMail secure email gateway that allows unauthenticated attackers to write arbitrary files on the underlying system via crafted HTTP/HTTPS requests. The flaw has been actively exploited in the wild as a zero-day, prompting urgent workaround guidance from the vendor.
items.title: [Advisory] Fortinet FortiMail: Path Traversal Exploited in Zero-Day Attacks (CVE-2026-104286)

items.summary: A set of security vulnerabilities has been fixed in Zimbra Collaboration, ranging from account takeover via the password recovery mechanism to multiple cross-site scripting (XSS) flaws. Additional issues allow remote code execution through the OnlyOffice integration and multi-factor authentication bypass in WebDAV.
items.title: [Advisory] Zimbra Collaboration: Account Takeover and XSS Vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-66912, CVE-2026-66911)

items.summary: A critical vulnerability has been disclosed in Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager that allows unauthenticated, remote attackers to bypass authentication and gain administrator-level access to the API. In September 2026, the Cisco PSIRT became aware of active exploitation of this vulnerability. Cisco strongly recommends that customers upgrade to a fixed software release to remediate this vulnerability.
items.title: [Advisory] Cisco Catalyst SD-WAN Manager: API Authentication Bypass (CVE-2026-76504)

items.summary: Multiple security vulnerabilities have been fixed in WatchGuard Access Points that allow attackers to bypass authentication and inject arbitrary operating system commands. Two of the flaws are rated critical.
items.title: [Advisory] WatchGuard AP: Authentication Bypass and Command Injection (CVE-2026-101891, CVE-2026-86102)

items.summary: A critical security warning has been issued for Kiteworks systems regarding an imminent zero-day exploit threat. Threat intelligence from law enforcement indicates that attacks against these systems may be launched globally. In response, the vendor has urgently requested customers to temporarily shut down their servers to mitigate the risk of compromise.
items.title: [Advisory] Kiteworks: Imminent Zero-Day Exploitation Risk

items.summary: Adobe has released security updates addressing vulnerabilities across multiple products, including critical flaws in ColdFusion, Campaign Classic, and Commerce. Successful exploitation could lead to arbitrary code execution, application denial-of-service, and privilege escalation.
items.title: [Advisory] Adobe August 2026 security updates fixed Critical vulnerabilities in ColdFusion, Campaign Classic & Commerce

items.summary: Multiple vulnerabilities have been identified in the Roundcube Webmail open-source software that could lead to the execution of malicious code. These flaws allow attackers to compromise systems through various attack vectors, including SQL injection and stored cross-site scripting (XSS).
items.title: [Advisory] Roundcube: Multiple vulnerabilities including injections  (XSS/HTML/CSS) and unauthenticated SQL Injection

items.summary: A critical zero-day vulnerability in F5 BIG-IP Access Policy Manager (APM) allows unauthenticated remote code execution on systems configured as OAuth authorization servers. The flaw is being actively exploited in the wild, and F5 has released emergency hotfixes.
items.title: [Advisory] F5 BIG-IP APM: Unauthenticated RCE on OAuth Servers (CVE-2026-94127)

items.summary: A critical security flaw has been found in Arista's VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO) on-premises. The vulnerability is being actively exploited and allows unauthenticated remote attackers to access privileged internal functionality, potentially leading to full system compromise and may also give attackers access to the Edge devices it manages..
items.title: [Advisory] Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator: Improper Input Validation Zero-Day (CVE-2026-93952)

items.summary: A critical security update has been released by Check Point to address two severe vulnerabilities in its VPN solutions, which could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected systems. The flaws affect a gateway, firewall and security management platforms.
items.title: [Advisory] Check Point VPN: Critical Remote Code Execution

items.summary: A critical security vulnerability has been disclosed in Check Point's Security Management Server that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary scripts on the server. The flaw stems from a path traversal bug in the management server's web service. Threat actors have already actively exploited this zero-day vulnerability in targeted attacks.
items.title: [Advisory] Check Point Security Management Server: Pre-Authentication Arbitrary Script Execution (CVE-2026-93616)

items.summary: Multiple critical security vulnerabilities have been disclosed in Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) that allow remote attackers to read or write arbitrary files and cause denial-of-service conditions without authentication.
items.title: [Advisory] Synology DiskStation Manager: Multiple Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Access Vulnerabilities

items.summary: A critical vulnerability has been discovered in NLnet Labs Unbound DNS resolver that allows remote code execution via a malicious DNS zone. An attacker who controls a malicious zone can query a vulnerable resolver to trigger a heap overflow in its validator. This vulnerability can lead to denial of service or arbitrary code execution.
items.title: [Advisory] NLnet Labs Unbound DNS resolver: Remote Code Execution (CVE-2026-81642)

items.summary: Multiple vulnerabilities have been disclosed in the Internet Systems Consortium's BIND 9 DNS server software. Some of which can be exploited by remote, unauthenticated attackers to trigger denial-of-service conditions, including unexpected program crashes and system resource exhaustion.
items.title: [Advisory] ISC BIND 9: Multiple Denial of Service Vulnerabilities

items.summary: A critical vulnerability has been patched in Check Point's Security Management and Log Servers that would allow unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code with root privileges over the network. The flaw resides in the pre-authentication login process and is reachable through the Trusted Clients configuration path.
items.title: [Advisory] Check Point: Unauthenticated RCE as Root in Management Server (CVE-2026-91843)

items.summary: Critical security vulnerabilities have been disclosed in Cisco's Secure Firewall Management Center (FMC) software that allow unauthenticated remote attackers to compromise affected devices. Successful exploitation of these flaws permits attackers to execute arbitrary code or bypass authentication mechanisms to gain root access to the underlying operating system.
items.title: [Advisory] Cisco Secure FMC: Authentication bypass and insecure deserialization Vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-20079 & CVE-2026-20131)

items.summary: on September 16, 2026, Cisco published a batch of security advisories addressing numerous critical and high-severity vulnerabilities across Identity Services Engine (ISE), Secure Firewall (ASA/FTD/FMC), and Nexus Dashboard.
items.title: [Advisory] Cisco: patches multiple Critical vulnerabilities across their products

items.summary: A critical vulnerability has been patched in Cisco Identity Services Engine (ISE) and Cisco ISE Passive Identity Connector (ISE-PIC) that would allows an unauthenticated remote attackers to bypass authentication. The Cisco PSIRT is aware of active exploitation of this vulnerability.
items.title: [Advisory] Cisco Identity Services Engine: Authentication Bypass actively exploited (CVE-2026-76460)

items.summary: A privilege-escalation vulnerability has been identified in LiteSpeed Web Server Enterprise. On shared-hosting servers, a malicious low-privilege website user could potentially gain root-level access to the server. This could allow an attacker to access or alter other hosted websites and the server itself.
items.title: [Advisory] LiteSpeed Enterprise: Privilege Escalation to Root on Shared Hosting

items.summary: A set of critical security vulnerabilities has been fixed in GitLab Community Edition (CE) and Enterprise Edition (EE) that could allow unauthenticated attackers to read arbitrary files from the server and authenticated attackers to access sensitive credentials. GitLab has released patches and strongly urges all self-managed installations to upgrade immediately.
items.title: [Advisory] GitLab: critical path traversal in repository commits API (CVE-2026-85706) and deserialization flaw (CVE-2026-87719)

items.summary: A critical security vulnerability has been identified in Cisco Secure Email Gateway that allows unauthenticated, remote attackers to execute arbitrary commands with root privileges. The vulnerability allows malicious SQL statements sent in a crafted email to trigger command execution on the underlying operating system. CISA has added this vulnerability to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog.
items.title: [Advisory] Cisco Secure Email Gateway: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution via SQL Injection (CVE-2026-76461)

items.summary: A critical security vulnerability has been disclosed in JFrog Artifactory that allows unauthenticated attackers with network access to bypass authentication and obtain administrative privileges under default configurations. This flaw is reportedly being actively exploited in the wild, with attackers utilizing the weakness to mint administrative tokens. Organizations using self-hosted instances are urged to apply the available updates immediately to secure their environments.
items.title: [Advisory] JFrog Artifactory: Administrative Access via Authentication Bypass (CVE-2026-82329)

items.summary: A new browser exploit kit dubbed "BlueMoon" was used by multiple espionage-motivated threat actors in late August early September 2026. The kit chains together two Chrome/Chromium zero-days (patch-gap) with a Windows kernel local privilege escalation (already reported individually in CSH). When a victim connects to the attacker controlled infrastructure through a vulnerable browser on a vulnerable Windows machine the chain of exploits results in SYSTEM-level code execution without the need of any further user interaction.
items.title: [Advisory] BlueMoon Exploit Kit

items.summary: Ivanti fixed multiple critical and high vulnerabilities across its products:  Neurons for ITSM, Sentry, and Endpoint Manager Mobile (EPMM). The most severe flaws allow remote code execution and authentication bypass, potentially granting attackers full control over affected systems.
items.title: [Advisory] Ivanti September 2026 Security Update

items.summary: A critical security vulnerability has been disclosed in SAP's Extended Passport (EPP) processing, a shared kernel component, enabling unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary operating system commands on the SAP host with full administrative privileges. Patches for additional critical vulnerabilities were also released during their September patch day, impacting NetWeaver Message Server, SAP CAP, and SAP GUI for Java.
items.title: [Advisory] SAP Extended Passport: Critical Kernel Flaw Enables Unauthenticated RCE (CVE-2026-44756)

items.summary: In its monthly security update for September 2026, Microsoft published fixes for nearly 1,000 vulnerabilities across its software portfolio, marking the largest single patch release in the company's history. The updates address numerous critical remote code execution and privilege escalation flaws, including two zero-day vulnerabilities that have been observed being actively exploited in the wild.
items.title: [Advisory] Microsoft Patch Tuesday September 2026

items.summary: A critical security vulnerability has been disclosed in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway that allows an attacker to bypass authentication mechanisms. Successful exploitation grants unauthenticated remote attackers access without requiring user interaction or elevated privileges, potentially compromising the network perimeter.
items.title: [Advisory] Citrix NetScaler and NetScaler Gateway: Authentication Bypass (CVE-2026-19490)

items.summary: A high-severity type confusion vulnerability in Google Chrome's V8 JavaScript engine allows remote code execution within the browser sandbox through a crafted HTML page. Google has confirmed active exploitation in the wild and released patches.
items.title: [Advisory] Google Chrome: Actively Exploited V8 Type Confusion (CVE-2026-85046)

items.summary: A critical zero-day vulnerability has been disclosed in N-able's N-central remote monitoring and management (RMM) platform, allowing unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution on the server. N-able has released a fourth hotfix within five weeks to address this vulnerability.
items.title: [Advisory] N-able N-central: Pre-Auth Remote Code Execution (CVE-2026-86218)

items.summary: A critical unpatched zero-day vulnerability, dubbed StyleSmuggler, has been seen actively exploited in Magento / Adobe Commerce, allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on an online store's server. The flaw is being actively exploited to install persistent backdoors.
items.title: [Advisory] Magento / Adobe Commerce: Unauthenticated RCE Zero-Day actively exploited (CVE-2026-75650 - StyleSmuggler)

items.summary: A critical security vulnerability has been disclosed in Cisco Nexus 9000 Series Switches equipped with Silicon One ASICs, allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code with root privileges.
items.title: [Advisory] Cisco Nexus 9000: Series Switches Silicon One Remote Code Execution (CVE-2026-20212)

items.summary: A critical vulnerability has been patched in VMware Workstation and Fusion that allows a malicious actor with local administrative privileges inside a guest virtual machine with VMXNET3 virtual network adapter to execute code on the underlying host. A second high-severity stack-based buffer overflow flaw has also been patched, which could allow code execution as the virtual machine's VMX process running on the host.
items.title: [Advisory] VMware Workstation & Fusion: Guest-to-Host Code Execution (CVE-2026-59346)

items.summary: Multiple vulnerabilities have been fixed in HPE Aruba Networking's ArubaOS-CX switch operating system that could allow unauthenticated attackers to remotely execute malicious code on affected CX-series switches. By sending specially crafted packets to affected devices, attackers can compromise the underlying switch without any user interaction.
items.title: [Advisory] HPE ArubaOS-CX: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (CVE-2026-73749)

items.summary: Two vulnerabilities in SonicWall’s SMA1000 secure access gateway have been patched. The flaws can be chained to achieve unauthenticated remote code execution, posing severe risk to affected appliances. SonicWall indicate that those vulnerabilities are actively exploited.
items.title: [Advisory] SonicWall SMA1000: Unauthenticated Remote Code Execution (CVE-2026-83548, CVE-2026-83549)

items.summary: WatchGuard has released security patches addressing multiple critical vulnerabilities in its Fireware OS and Dimension management platform. Unauthenticated attackers can exploit these security flaws to execute arbitrary code remotely, cause denial-of-service conditions, or perform administrative account takeovers. Organizations are advised to update their affected appliances immediately to prevent potential exploitation.
items.title: [Advisory] WatchGuard: Multiple Remote Code Execution vulnerabilities patched

items.summary: A set of critical security vulnerabilities has been disclosed in the ServiceNow AI Platform and Now Platform that could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code, run SQL statements against the underlying database, and escalate privileges. ServiceNow has deployed updates to hosted instances and provided patches to partners and self-hosted customers.
items.title: [Advisory] ServiceNow AI Platform: Unauthenticated RCE and SQL Injection (CVE-2026-18885, CVE-2026-18886, CVE-2026-74820)

items.summary: A critical security update has been released by Ubiquiti to address 22 vulnerabilities affecting numerous UniFi ecosystem products. Many of these flaws carry maximum severity ratings, enabling network-based attackers to bypass authentication, execute arbitrary commands, or escalate privileges on host devices.
items.title: [Advisory] Ubiquiti: Multiple Critical Vulnerabilities

items.summary: Two unauthenticated vulnerabilities in Kaltura’s mwEmbed/html5lib video player allow remote attackers to read arbitrary files and execute arbitrary code. The flaws stem from an undocumented `ServiceUrl` parameter that controls a server-side fetch and an unsafe PHP `unserialize()` operation.
items.title: [Advisory] Kaltura mwEmbed: Unauthenticated RCE and Arbitrary File Read

items.summary: Two critical vulnerabilities have been disclosed in the Xecurify miniOrange SAML 2.0 Single Sign-On plugin for WordPress, allowing unauthenticated attackers to forge SAML responses and log in as any existing user, including administrators. Active exploitation is underway, and public proof-of-concept code is available.
items.title: [Advisory] miniOrange SAML SSO: WordPress Admin Authentication Bypass

items.summary: A critical security vulnerability has been disclosed in Keycloak, the open-source identity and access management (IAM) tool, allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to take over any user account by exploiting a weakness in the password reset flow. The flaw bypasses the emailed action token and permits direct password reset, including administrative accounts.
items.title: [Advisory] Keycloak: Unauthenticated account takeover via reset-credentials flow bypass (CVE-2026-18963)

items.summary: A critical security vulnerability has been identified in GitLab Community Edition (CE) and Enterprise Edition (EE) that allows unauthorized attackers to modify or delete content within public projects. An additional high-severity flaw related to Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) was also addressed in in an out-of-band release which contains important bug and security fixes
items.title: [Advisory] GitLab: Unauthenticated Project Data Deletion (CVE-2026-19478)

items.summary: Cisco has released security updates to address multiple critical vulnerabilities in its Crosswork and Secure Workload software platforms. If successfully exploited, these flaws could allow remote attackers to execute arbitrary code, bypass authentication mechanisms, and gain unauthorized access to the affected applications.
items.title: [Advisory] Cisco: Multiple Critical Vulnerabilities in Crosswork and Secure Workload

items.summary: Oracle has released its August 2026 Critical Security Patch Update (CSPU), addressing over 900 vulnerabilities across multiple families. A significant portion of these flaws are highly critical and can be exploited remotely by unauthenticated attackers, potentially leading to widespread system compromises.
items.title: [Advisory] Oracle: Multiple Critical Vulnerabilities fixed in August 2026 Critical Security Patch Update (CSPU)

items.summary: Critical security vulnerabilities have been discovered in two widely used WordPress plugins, Forminator Forms, User Profile Builder and Royal Elementor Addons. These flaws could allow unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code, and authenticated attackers to forge server-side requests or inject malicious scripts into affected websites.
items.title: [Advisory] Various WordPress Plugins: Critical RCE, SSRF and XSS

items.summary: This post will centralize updates on publications of zero days by security researchers Nightmare Eclipse that started in April 2026 and where future publications are expected.
items.title: [Advisory] Microsoft: Nightmare Eclipse zero days publications

items.summary: A potential zero-day affecting GeoServer has been published. The alleged flaw is an SQL injection issue in the `jsonArrayContains` function that, under certain configurations, could be leveraged to achieve remote code execution. According to reports, exploitation of the unpatched vulnerability beggan within hours of its public disclosure.
items.title: [Advisory] GeoServer: Potential Zero-Day SQL Injection

items.summary: A vulnerability has been disclosed in Citrix NetScaler ADC and NetScaler Gateway configured as a SAML Identity Provider (IDP). Unauthenticated attackers can exploit this flaw to trigger an out-of-bounds memory read, allowing them to extract sensitive memory contents from the affected appliance.
items.title: [Advisory] Citrix NetScaler: Unauthenticated memory disclosure when configured as SAML IDP (CVE-2026-8451, cve-2026-8452)

items.summary: A series of critical security vulnerabilities have been addressed in SAP's enterprise software portfolio, most notably affecting SAP Commerce Cloud, Manufacturing Integration and Intelligence (MII), and Application Server ABAP. Successful exploitation of these flaws could allow attackers to execute arbitrary code, cause system crashes, or gain unauthorized access to sensitive business data.
items.title: [Advisory] SAP: multiple critical vulnerabilities in August 2026 monthly patch release

items.summary: In its monthly security update of July 2026, Microsoft published more then 600 vulnerabilities, including 480 bugs in Chromium and Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based).
items.title: [Advisory] Microsoft Patch Tuesday July 2026

items.summary: Broadcom has released security patches addressing multiple vulnerabilities across VMware ESX, vCenter, Workstation, and Fusion. The most severe flaws include a critical virtual machine (VM) escape and an authentication bypass, potentially granting attackers full control over affected host systems and management servers.
items.title: [Advisory] VMware: Multiple Critical Vulnerabilities in ESX, vCenter, Workstation and Fusion (VMSA-2026-0006)
